about: Purchase the Lost Judgment Digital Deluxe edition to receive the following in-game contents: -Lost Judgment base game -Detective Essentials Pack -School Stories Expansion Pack
When a convicted police officer reveals the location of a murder victim, Private Detective Yagami is called to revisit an impossible case of two crimes committed at once.
But as more victims pile up and Yagami unravels the truth, will the scales of justice tip in favor of defending the law or enacting vengeance?
From the studio that brought you the Yakuza series, Lost Judgment weaves elements of investigative sleuthing, noir narrative and action combat into one mystery thriller.
Take your detective expertise to the streets of Japan and defend those that the law fails to protect.
